overall: The AG found no evidence that a quorum of the Hinsdale Select Board deliberated outside a meeting over a conduct rule set, and closed the matter with no violation.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated outside a noticed meeting on a conduct rule set, based on the Chair drafting it and circulating it to members before a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Law specifically allows for the distribution of the document in anticipation of its discussion at a meeting.
